main_text.p: Diœcesis vniuersus Occidens fait quo nomine cum Alexandrino Patriarchâ in Nicena Synodo comparatur, ob speciale diœcesin. At, vt Papa est, & Princeps Pastorum, Diœcesis eius non tantùm Occidens, sed Orbis est vniuersus. Hæc Iesuita; & sic Tyber vester, veluti mare immensum, ambitione tanquam turbine turgescens, sæpe extra Totius Christiani Orbis ripas difluxisset, nisi Deus Opt. Maximus, vt illius elementaris, ita huius quoque Ecclesiastici maris superbis vndis certos quosdam fines posuisset, coercendo impetum eius, & dicendo: Hucusque, & non ultrà.

Exempli causa; Vniuersalis, quam vendicat, authoritas, in Bellar.lib.1.de Conc.c.12.{a}Vniuersalibus Concilijs congregandis, Cusanus Card. Concord.Cath.l.2. c.25.{b}Per octo prima Generalia Concilia, quæ erant ab Imperatoribus congregata, refutata fuit: vt & per Theodosium Imperatorem, à quo Leo Papa (quem dicis vocari Vniuersalem Episcopum) licet multâ supplicatione sæpius obnixè peteret, tamen vt Concilium celebraretur vel intra Italiam, non potuit obtinere. Authoritas Vniuersalis Decreti Conciliorum approbandi vel improbandi à Concilio Sardicensi repressa; vbi in {d}Forma præscribitur Cusanus ibid. lib.1.c.15.ne lideret Papa sententiam Synodi improbare. Authoritas & prærogatiua vniuersalis non labendi in Hæresin protrita per Tria * Concilia Generalia; in quibus Honorius Papa Anathema pronunciatur. Supra c.3.fol.39.Vniuersalis Papæ{e} Immunitas, vt nunquàm conciliùm potestatem vllâ deponatur, per Concilium etiam Romæ habitum {f}Con-tra Iohannem XII. Papam; post à Conc. Constantiensi, & Basileensi explosa. Vniuersalis Iurisdictio in excommunicandis alienis Ecclesijs primò ab {g}Alianis Episcopis, contra Victorem Papam; post à * Carthaginensibus, contra Stephanum Papam, tanquam Tyrannicus terror, & super-bâ ambitio reiecta. Vniuersalis potestas {h}Appellationum in Conc. Africano, tanquam fumosus sæculi typhus, vel repugnante Papa Bonifacio, displosa. Vniuersale ius ordinandi aut constituendi Patriarchas alios in * Conc.Florentino à Græcis aduersus Eugenium denegatum. Vniuersalis præ-
e Bellar.lib.2.de Pont.c.26. & l.2. de Conc.c.17.

page.notes: Right margin notes are placed at the marker positions. Marker letters a–h are read from the scan and some are uncertain. The margin items "Supra c.3.fol.39.", "Supra c.1.fol.4.", "Supra de Cypriano & Surius Tom.1.Conc.pag.", "Supra Cap.3.§.2." and "242." are printed beside the lines but their marker letters could not be matched with certainty, so they are omitted from the notes and should be checked. The word "Vistoria" in the margin is read as "Victoria" and is uncertain. The running head "Differtatio" is read as "Dissertatio", since the long s is unclear. The Latin text contains a few ambiguous letters in "Diœcesis", "Concilium" and "Alianis", which are reproduced as printed. The stamp "Digitized by Google" at the lower right is excluded.
